svg.title: ReasonAI Backend detailed architecture: FastAPI modular monolith, security, PostgreSQL transactions, learning domains, offline sync, Knowledge Feed and Cloud Run discovery job
svg.desc: Web, Flutter and administrator clients authenticate through Supabase. FastAPI on Cloud Run validates bearer JWTs, CORS and request bodies, routes Pydantic requests to domain application services, and uses request-scoped SQLAlchemy 2 units of work with psycopg 3 and Supabase PostgreSQL. Modules include identity, catalog, learning, practice, review, diagram persistence, Knowledge Feed, offline sync, publishing, admin, search and events. A separate Cloud Run Job uses an advisory lock, Tavily news and Hacker News discovery, content recency and image validation, Nebius Token Factory Nemotron structured enrichment, Cloudflare R2 images and atomic PostgreSQL commits. FastAPI serves deterministically ranked prepared feeds without per-scroll LLM inference. Next.js LangGraph interactive agents, Vercel Queue and Nebius ConTree trusted DSA Submit, and Go WebSocket room collaboration are adjacent services, not FastAPI modules.

g.text: Deterministic domain systems · authenticated product APIs · offline intelligence
Public clients make authenticated calls; Supabase handles sessions, not business-domain authorization
FastAPI derives the effective profile and roles — never trusts client-supplied user IDs
One Python modular monolith; explicit input, identity, workflow and persistence boundaries
Each application workflow opens a request-scoped transaction; retries and conflicts are handled at the domain boundary.
Server-owned business state; publication and learning changes remain independently testable
Separately deployed Cloud Run Job; prepared stories enter the normal read path after processing
Refresh API may trigger job; credentials for Tavily, Nebius and R2 writes stay on the Job
Online GET /knowledge/feed = PostgreSQL ranking + signed cursor; no Nemotron / Tavily calls per scroll
Explicit integration ownership prevents duplicated runtime, judging or collaboration responsibilities
Room ops / ACK / replay · transient state
FastAPI owns product truth · Cloud Run Job enriches offline · AI, ConTree judging and Go collaboration remain separate
Deterministic data · bounded inference · explicit trust
